changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`

- names `WizardForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `WizardStepConfig` is now declared independently in `WizardForm.tsx`, which is simply what `SplitFormSectionConfig`, `ModalFormSectionConfig` and `DrawerFormSectionConfig` already do: each layout owns its group shape, documents `className` / `gridClassName` in its own terms, and declares `visibleWhen` only where its renderer honours it. The derivation flips from subtractive to additive — a key is authorable on a wizard step only if someone writes it there.

### `.changeset/8738-object-form-fields-description.md`

- names `ObjectForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The registration declared `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' }` with no description, so an author had nowhere to read that this key's members are **bare field names** — a different vocabulary from `sections[].fields`, which also accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object (identity key `field`, e.g. `{ field: 'note', colSpan: 2 }`). Moving one of those objects to the top-level `fields` resolves to no name and is skipped by `SimpleObjectForm` (`ObjectForm.tsx`) and by `buildFlatFields` (`flatFields.ts`, shared by the drawer/modal presentations). Behaviour is unchanged by this entry; it only adds the description text an author would need to avoid the drop before writing it.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `bc97f9247` (merge-base with origin/main): 8 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1534 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2120 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36178924787)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `45086fa4f11dd2376d086a803b5b6dfe7251be0b`

### ① Derived judgments

Read: card objectui#10682 (body, triage `5837519011`, claim `5837585890`; the `os-dev-report` comment skipped as instructed), objectui#10578, objectui#10683, PR objectui#10680 (merged 2026-09-25T17:33Z), PR objectui#10650 (open, draft, head `b5d6751`; files `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and two pins, none of the six forms), PR #10704 body and file list, and `refs/review/pr-10704` (= `45086fa`) against merge-base `69a6fc1` (3 commits: `d41377b` the fix, `a172199` and `45086fa` merges of main). 9 files, +667/−19. Git-only review: no checkout and no run of the pin; the red/green counts below are the author's, checked against the sources by reading.

Binding text, triage `5837519011`: 「the objectui#10578 shape, clearing on a successful commit, applied per source. Each form has two reads (the object schema and the record) and no run guard, so a record read that succeeds over a failed schema read must not clear the schema failure.」, 「One enumeration pin over the seven sites」 (fail, then succeed, then the value or rows shown), and 「Region order: the `LineItemsPanel` row goes after PR objectui#10650 (objectui#10631, p1, open)」. Claim `5837585890` limits: 「⛔ Not `LineItemsPanel.tsx` in PR 1」, 「⛔ Not the fetch effects' dependency lists, and ⛔ no new published prop」.

1. New helper `packages/plugin-form/src/loadFailure.ts` (85 lines). `beginLoadRun` :61-77 numbers one run per source (`++seqRef.current[source]` :66); `fail` :69-71 writes only `[source]` and only while current; `commit` :72-75 clears only `[source]`, only while current, and only if set; `shownLoadFailure` :83-85 is `failures.schema || failures.record`. RIGHT against 「clearing on a successful commit, applied per source」: the clear is keyed to the committing source and nothing clears at run start, the shape `ObjectGantt` carries on main (`packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:846` and `:950`, `setError(null)` at commit under `isCurrent()`, none at start). Reachability: `index.tsx` has 0 `export *` lines and 0 mentions of it; `package.json` `exports` is `.` only; both untouched vs the merge-base; imported by the six forms only. Private, so not a published-surface change. It is one file beyond the claim's named list; judged in scope as the implementation of the `error` lifecycle inside `packages/plugin-form/src/`.

2. State swap, the one `useState` for `error` replaced by the failure pair, a run ref and a derived `error`: `ObjectForm.tsx:597-599`, `DrawerForm.tsx:250-252`, `ModalForm.tsx:280-282`, `SplitForm.tsx:181-183`, `TabbedForm.tsx:285-287`, `WizardForm.tsx:440-442`. Render untouched: `if (error)` still precedes `if (loading)` and the form on all six (ObjectForm :1454/:1464, Drawer :668/:677, Modal :689/:698, Split :432/:441, Tabbed :520/:529, Wizard :977/:986), heading `Error loading form` unchanged. RIGHT.

3. Schema read. Run begun as the first statement of the effect body: ObjectForm :684, Drawer :282, Modal :360, Split :189, Tabbed :298, Wizard :510. Commit after `setObjectSchema`: ObjectForm :702 (the read), :711 (the inline fallback inside the catch), :732 (the inline-only branch, no read); Drawer :291, Modal :369, Split :198, Tabbed :308, Wizard :520. Fail in the catch: ObjectForm :715, Drawer :293, Modal :371, Split :200, Tabbed :310, Wizard :522. RIGHT: each former `setError` site became `run.fail`, and each successful schema commit clears only its own failure.

4. Record read. Run begun first: ObjectForm :798, Drawer :326, Modal :404, Split :234, Tabbed :344, Wizard :534. Commit on the read: ObjectForm :833, Drawer :369, Modal :449, Split :270, Tabbed :371, Wizard :560; on the seed branches (create mode, no `recordId`, or no data source, which write `formData` from something other than a read): ObjectForm :805, Drawer :336/:345, Modal :416/:425, Split :244/:253, Tabbed :354, Wizard :547. Fail: ObjectForm :816 (no data source) and :840 (catch); Drawer :372, Modal :452, Split :273, Tabbed :374, Wizard :562. RIGHT. A seed clearing the record failure is a commit of values in place of what the failed read was for; the PR body discloses it.

5. Value writes: none other than the error one move. The 19 removed lines are exactly the 6 `useState` lines and the 13 `setError` writes (merge-base counts 3/2/2/2/2/2 for ObjectForm/Drawer/Modal/Split/Tabbed/Wizard, `setError(null)` 0); the added lines are comments, the import block, the state trio, `beginLoadRun`, `run.commit()` and `run.fail()` (a scan of the diff for any other added line: 0). `setLoading`, `setObjectSchema`, `setFormData`, `setInitialData`, `setPersistedRecord` and the `loadedRecord*` refs are byte-identical. Inside the claim.

6. Fetch-effect dependency lists: 0 changed lines touch `useEffect(`, `useCallback(`, `useMemo(` or a deps array. Deps at head unchanged: schema `[schema.objectName, dataSource]` (Drawer :298, Modal :376, Split :205, Tabbed :315, Wizard :527) and `[schema.objectName, dataSource, hasInlineFields]` (ObjectForm :737); record `[objectSchema, schema.mode, schema.recordId, schema.initialData, schema.initialValues, dataSource, schema.objectName]` (Drawer :382, Modal :462, Split :283, Tabbed :384, Wizard :571) and ObjectForm :849 with `hasInlineFields, recordRefetch` added. A state setter and a ref need no entry. The claim limit holds.

7. No new published prop: no props interface or registration line is in the diff; `index.tsx` untouched. `LineItemsPanel.tsx` is not in the file list; PR objectui#10650, its editor, is still open, so the region order is respected and the seventh pin site's absence is expected.

Per-source rule, judged on each form:
- (i) A record read that succeeds must not clear a schema failure: MET on all six. The record commit writes `record: null` only (`loadFailure.ts:74`). Its premise, that such a read runs only over an earlier object's schema, holds: a `findOne` needs `objectSchema` in state and a data source (gates ObjectForm :846 `objectSchema && !hasInlineFields`; Drawer :378, Modal :458, Split :279, Tabbed :380, Wizard :568 `objectSchema || !dataSource`, whose no-data-source arm seeds and never reads), and a failed schema read never writes `objectSchema` (ObjectForm's inline fallback :710-711 writes one, but as a commit, not a failure).
- (ii) A schema read that succeeds must not clear a record failure: MET on all six by the same write (`schema: null` only). NOT PINNED: no row sets a record failure and then commits a schema read. Not asked verbatim by the triage; recorded as a gap under ③.
- (iii) A superseded run neither sets nor clears: MET on all six. `beginLoadRun` is the first statement of each effect body, so a re-run supersedes before any await; both writes check `isCurrent()`. On Drawer/Modal/Split/Tabbed the pre-existing `cancelled` flag (Drawer :362/:371, Modal :442/:451, Split :263/:272, Tabbed :364/:373) returns first; on ObjectForm and Wizard the sequence is the only guard. A superseded run's VALUES still land on ObjectForm and Wizard: pre-existing, byte-identical, disclosed, outside the claim.

Pin `packages/plugin-form/src/recordFormsErrorClears-10682.test.tsx` (365 lines): `describe.each` over the six layouts (:124-131, :204), nine rows each, plus the bus row :350-364: 55 cases (6 × 9 + 1).
- Lit control :205-211: record drawn, no error screen, one schema read, one record read. Present on all six.
- Negative legs, red on the base sources by reading (13 writes, 0 clears): :213 a record read fails then a `recordId: 'r2'` read succeeds, base leaves the error set (6 red); :229 a failed background re-read then a success (6 red); :281 a superseded record read fails, base `ObjectForm.tsx:807` and `WizardForm.tsx:535` set the error with no `cancelled` guard (2 red; the four guarded layouts green on base); :313 a superseded schema read fails, no schema catch is guarded on base (6 red); :351 the filed bus probe (1 red). 21 red of 55, which is the author's base-leg count.
- Rows green on base that discriminate only against a wrong fix: :245 (rule i) reddens if `commit` clears both sources; :333 (rule iii, schema) reddens on all six and :298 (rule iii, record) on ObjectForm and Wizard if `commit` drops its current check (the four's `cancelled` returns before the commit). By reading, these agree with the author's A1 (6 red) and A2 (8 red) ablations; A3 (`fail` without its check) reddens :281 on two and :313 on six (8). Not re-run here.
- The second read is real on every row: the `recordId` swap is in all six record deps; the `objectName` swap is in both effects' deps on all six; the default arm's background re-read is the bus (`useDataInvalidation` ObjectForm :758-761, `'*'` matched by `packages/react/src/data-invalidation.ts:87`, `recordRefetch` bumped at :777 while pristine and listed at :849); the five others re-run their record read on `initialValues: {}` because `schema.initialValues` is in their deps, the block's `initialValues` is forwarded by ObjectForm's routing spreads (:340 `...schema` tabbed, :412 wizard, :448 split, :483 `...drawerRest`, :519 `...modalRest`), and the read is in place because `loadedRecordIdRef.current === schema.recordId` (Drawer :355, Tabbed :360). The component's own comment names this host rebuild as common (Drawer :300-303). No test-only hook. The other five import neither `useDataInvalidation` nor `notifyDataChanged` (0 hits each), consistent with the PR's 1-to-1 probe.
- `shownError()` :155-160 keys on the h3 `Error loading form`, which all six render; each layout's :213 row first asserts the screen is up after a failure, so a missing heading could not pass a `toBeNull` silently.

Missing asks: none for PR 1. Done but not asked: the private helper (in scope, item 1) and explanatory comments. Existing pins edited or deleted: none; the diff adds one test file and edits no test, so no guard is weakened.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10682-form-error-clears.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-form': patch`. Not docs-only (8 source files of one released package). A bug fix; no export, prop, schema or accept set moves. AGENTS.md 版本号策略: never `major`; a breaking change of objectui's own is `minor`; this is not breaking, so `patch` is the right level. The package is in `.changeset/config.json` `fixed`, so the group moves together, as the policy intends. CI `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report` and `Changeset Claim Re-read`: success.

Changeset prose, sentence by sentence:
1. Title line (a failed read no longer keeps a record form on its error screen after a later read of the same kind succeeds): TRUE (rows :213, :229, :351 by reading).
2.
